mode.description: Operational mode: empty for default info, 'timer' for countdown, 'stopwatch' for stopwatch, 'date_diff' or 'time_diff' for calculations.

second_target.description: Secondary date/time/duration argument for comparisons or arithmetic (e.g., 'today', '1983 Jul 3').

operation.description: Arithmetic operation: 'add', 'sub', or 'day' (show weekday). Empty for difference.

quiet.description: Enable quiet mode to suppress output until interrupted or command execution.

run_command.description: Shell command to run when a countdown timer reaches zero (e.g., 'notify-send pdd expired').
